title: 第229章  赌命
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

天峰茶会这一天，中海的天阴得很低。

清晨六点，天峰山脚便已封路。

江家的车队最先抵达，几辆黑色商务车停在第一道检查岗外，江怀远亲自下车，与负责外围封控的人逐一确认名单。

今日上山的人，每一个都经过三重核验。

随身物品。

普通宾客早已取消，媒体也被挡在山外。

对外说法是徐家事件牵连山庄安全审查，茶会缩小为内部武道交流。

可真正走进天峰山的人都知道，这不是什么茶会。

这是一座被临时搭起来的战场。

霍家的车队随后抵达。

霍景渊今日穿着一身黑色长衣，头发束起，神色冷静，身后跟着秦老与霍家精锐。

他们负责山庄东侧与露台外围防线。

再往后，是金石门的人。

陆沉走在最前。

灰衣，黑刀。

他的脸上依旧没有多余表情。

叶霜跟在他身后，目光时不时扫向后方那辆封闭车。

车里坐着金无烈和蒋云天。

金无烈右臂被黑布缠住，手腕上扣着执法锁。

外人看不出什么，只会以为这位金石门外事长老受了伤。

只有少数几人知道，他体内藏着一枚被反封的人形阵眼。

蒋云天则坐在另一侧。

他脸色苍白，身上同样带着锁链，但那锁链不是为了囚他，而是为了在他被井下声音牵动时，第一时间固定住他的经脉。

叶霜看着他，眼神复杂。

蒋云天勉强笑了笑。

“放心，我今天不发疯。”

叶霜低声道：“你最好说到做到。”

蒋云天看向窗外天峰山。

“我要是做不到，就让陆沉斩了我。”

叶霜张了张嘴，却没有说出话。

车外，陆沉似乎听见了。

他没有回头，只淡淡道：“我会。”

蒋云天苦笑。

“真是一点安慰都不给。”

叶霜反倒因此稍稍松了口气。

陆沉能这么说，说明他确实会盯住蒋云天。

也会在最后一刻前，尽力让他活着。

杏林阁的车队最后到。

宋青山从车上下来时，山风正从天峰山深处吹来，带着一丝阴冷潮意。

他今日穿了一身黑色劲装，袖中藏着假魂玉，眉心守井印被他以气息遮掩。

沈冰心随他下车。

药箱在身，银针在袖，神情比往日更清冷。

江明珠也来了。

她今日没有穿太显眼的衣服，只是一身简单利落的白色外套。

看似普通，实则内衬里缝着沈冰心调配的驱蛊药囊。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

On the day of the Tianfeng Tea Party, the sky in Zhonghai was very cloudy.

At six o'clock in the morning, the road was closed at the foot of Tianfeng Mountain.

The Jiang family's motorcade was the first to arrive. Several black commercial vehicles were parked outside the first inspection post. Jiang Huaiyuan got out of the car in person and confirmed the list one by one with the person responsible for peripheral sealing and control.

Everyone who goes up the mountain today has passed triple verification.

Personal belongings.

Ordinary guests have long been cancelled, and the media have been kept out.

The external theory is that the Xu family incident involved the security review of the villa, and the tea party was reduced to an internal martial arts exchange.

But anyone who has really walked into Tianfeng Mountain knows that this is not a tea party.

This is a makeshift battlefield.

The Huo family's motorcade arrived later.

Huo Jingyuan was wearing a long black coat today, his hair was tied up, and he looked calm. He was followed by Mr. Qin and the elite of the Huo family.

They are responsible for the defense line on the east side of the villa and the outer perimeter of the terrace.

Further behind are the people from Jinshimen.

Lu Chen walked in the front.

Gray clothes, black knife.

There was still no extra expression on his face.

Ye Shuang followed him, glancing at the closed car behind him from time to time.

Sitting in the car were Jin Wulie and Jiang Yuntian.

Jin Wuyeol's right arm was wrapped in black cloth, with a law enforcement lock on his wrist.

Outsiders couldn't see anything and would just think that the Jinshimen foreign affairs elder was injured.

Only a few people know that there is a sealed human-shaped formation eye hidden in his body.

Jiang Yuntian sat on the other side.

His face was pale, and he was also wearing chains, but the chains were not to imprison him, but to immobilize his meridians as soon as he was affected by the sound underground.

Ye Shuang looked at him with complicated eyes.

Jiang Yuntian forced a smile.

"Don't worry, I won't go crazy today."

Ye Shuang whispered: "You'd better keep your word."

Jiang Yuntian looked out the window at Tianfeng Mountain.

"If I can't do it, let Lu Chen kill me."

Ye Shuang opened her mouth, but did not speak.

Outside the car, Lu Chen seemed to hear it.

He didn't look back, just said calmly: "I will."

Jiang Yuntian smiled bitterly.

"It really doesn't give any comfort at all."

Ye Shuang actually breathed a sigh of relief.

The fact that Lu Chen can say this shows that he will indeed keep an eye on Jiang Yuntian.

I will try my best to keep him alive until the last moment.

Xinglin Pavilion’s motorcade arrived last.

When Song Qingshan got off the car, the mountain wind was blowing from the depths of Tianfeng Mountain, carrying a hint of coldness.

He was wearing a black outfit today, with a fake soul jade hidden in his sleeves, and the well mark between his eyebrows was covered with his breath.

Shen Bingxin got off the car with him.

The medicine box is on his body, the silver needle is on his sleeve, and his expression is colder than before.

Jiang Mingzhu is also here.

She didn't wear anything too conspicuous today, just a simple and neat white coat.

It looks ordinary, but in fact, there is a pouch of poison-repelling medicine prepared by Shen Bingxin sewn into the inner lining.
